turns.question: On which day of the week were the most orders placed between 17 August and 27 September 2026, and how many orders were placed on that weekday in total?
turns.answer: No single weekday had the most: every weekday (Monday to Sunday) had exactly 24 orders placed between 17 August and 27 September 2026, so they are tied at 24 orders each. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
